IAF Chief Discusses AI, Digital Twins, and Theaterization

Air Chief Marshal AP Singh stated the Indian Air Force (IAF) is adopting predictive Artificial Intelligence (AI) and digital twins to prepare for future challenges. He also clarified that the IAF is not against the concept of theaterization, advocating for an objective, step-by-step approach to its implementation. These remarks were made in recent coverage by centrist outlets.
